message: It is completely normal to feel upset. Let's take three slow breaths together.
Big feelings can feel heavy, {child_name}. Shake out your hands and take a breath.
Your brain worked hard today. Stretch your arms up to the sky and rest a minute.
It's okay to feel sad right now, {child_name}. You are safe and doing your best.
You're in a great calm space. Keep this gentle rhythm going!
Love seeing that smile, {child_name}! Let's ride this positive wave!
